title: Rice Cooker Teriyaki Shrimp
summary: This rice cooker teriyaki shrimp and rice combines tender shrimp, veggies and rice in a sweet and savory sauce for an easy, hands-off family dinner.
steps: Start the rice. Rinse the rice thoroughly until the water runs mostly clear, then drain well. Add the rice and 1¾ cups water or broth to your rice cooker and start it using the normal white rice setting.

Add the shrimp and vegetables. For a standard rice cooker, when there are about 7–10 minutes of cooking time remaining, quickly open the lid and arrange the raw shrimp in a single layer over the rice. Scatter the edamame and shredded carrots on top. If you have a pressure-style rice cooker, wait until the pressure releases and there are about 5 minutes left in the cycle. Then add the ingredients.
Drizzle the teriyaki sauce evenly over the shrimp and vegetables, then immediately close the lid so you don't lose too much steam.
Allow the rice cooker to complete its normal cooking cycle. The trapped steam will cook the shrimp and vegetables while the rice finishes underneath.

Once the shrimp are fully cooked, gently fluff the rice and stir everything together so the teriyaki sauce, shrimp, edamame, and carrots are evenly distributed. Serve warm with extra teriyaki sauce or your favorite toppings, if desired.
